chapter_seo_title: Li Huowang Faces His Darkest Question Yet — Is the Real World Even Real?
chapter_meta_description: A mother's love meets a philosophical bomb. Li Huowang survives decapitation only to question everything he knows about reality itself in this devastating chapter.
og_title: Li Huowang’s Greatest Fear: “What If the Real World Is Real?”
og_description: After escaping death by cheeky artifact, our protagonist must face a question that shakes the entire foundation of the novel.
twitter_title: Li Huowang’s Mom Drops a Rice Bomb on Reality
twitter_description: A mother’s warning about the gold, and a Heart-Element’s doubt about the nature of reality—this chapter will break you.

lore_anchors.definition: A rare human constitution capable of turning falsehood into reality, making the bearer both valuable and dangerous as an involuntary reality-warper.
The modern-world counterpart to the White Jade Capital in the novel's meta-structure, representing one of the two real/false poles Li Huowang must navigate.
